pages.headline: 🚨 Johnny Kenny hits the post!
pages.caption: We go close to scoring
pages.explanation: Johnny Kenny (Celtic) hits the left post with a right footed shot from the left side of the box. Assisted by Luke McCowan.

pages.headline: ⚽ Johnny Kenny!
pages.caption: We extend our advantage.
pages.explanation: Goal! Celtic 1, Kilmarnock 0. Johnny Kenny (Celtic) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Reo Hatate.

pages.headline: 🚨 Bruce Anderson hits the post!
pages.caption: Kilmarnock threaten the goal
pages.explanation: Bruce Anderson (Kilmarnock) hits the left post with a left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box. Assisted by Eddie Beach following a set piece situation.

pages.headline: Half-time whistle
pages.body:
Score at the break: Celtic 1-0 Kilmarnock.

We take a lead into the interval after a strong first half.

pages.headline: ⚽ Kieran Tierney!
pages.caption: We extend our advantage.
pages.explanation: Goal! Celtic 2, Kilmarnock 0. Kieran Tierney (Celtic) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Liam Scales.

pages.headline: ⚽ Daizen Maeda extends the lead!
pages.caption: We tighten their grip on the match with another goal.
pages.explanation: Goal! Celtic 3, Kilmarnock 0. Daizen Maeda (Celtic) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Arne Engels with a through ball.

pages.headline: Penalty awarded!
pages.caption: We earn a golden chance from the spot.
pages.explanation: Penalty Celtic. Yang Hyun-Jun draws a foul in the penalty area. Penalty conceded by James Brown (Kilmarnock) after a foul in the penalty area.

pages.headline: ⚽ Arne Engels from the spot!
pages.caption: We open the scoring and set the tone of the match.
pages.explanation: Goal! Celtic 4, Kilmarnock 0. Arne Engels (Celtic) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.

pages.headline: We Won! 🏆
pages.body:
Full Time: Celtic 4-0 Kilmarnock

Venue: Celtic Park
Competition: Scottish Premiership
Matchweek: 12
Stage: 1st Phase

⚽ Arne Engels on the scoresheet

We take all three points with a dominant performance.
